market.why: Major indices, including the S&P 500 and Nasdaq Composite, closed lower amidst warnings from institutions like Norway's sovereign wealth fund about "tougher times ahead" and not expecting continued blowout returns. Concerns about a "leverage buildup" in the market were also noted, contributing to a cautious sentiment, while geopolitical events like Houthi attacks in the Red Sea and the closure of Hormuz impacting oil supply further added to uncertainty.

yield_10y.why: The 10-year Treasury yield saw a marginal decrease. This coincided with consumer prices rising an expected 0.1% in July, bringing the annual inflation rate to 3.4%, which may have slightly eased concerns about aggressive monetary tightening. Mortgage rates also experienced a slight decline, potentially influenced by bond market movements.

vix.why: The VIX, a measure of market volatility, registered a slight decrease. This suggests that despite a downturn in the main stock indices, there was no significant surge in market fear or unexpected shocks, possibly due to inflation data meeting expectations rather than surprising the market.

policy_upcoming.what_happened: A Utah bill modifies provisions related to the property tax exemption process.
policy_upcoming.effect: Once you own a home, you will have deadlines for filing an application for a property tax exemption with the county board of equalization and for the board to render a decision.

policy_upcoming.what_happened: A bill amends requirements for health insurance preauthorization in Utah.
policy_upcoming.effect: Your health insurer must make an authorization or adverse preauthorization determination within a defined maximum time.

policy_calendar.label: Utah Truth in Taxation hearings — expected during August
policy_calendar.note: A Utah taxing entity that wants more property tax revenue than the certified rate allows must hold a public hearing, and those hearings are held in August. The county's Notice of Property Valuation and Tax Changes, mailed in July, carries the actual date and place for a given parcel.

tech.summary: SpaceXAI has launched Grok Bot, an AI agent service designed to operate as an independent "AI teammate" capable of performing multi-step workplace tasks by logging into and interacting with various applications and websites.
Gamgee, a new startup, aims to provide personalized mRNA cancer vaccines for dogs, building on an Australian entrepreneur's previous work utilizing AI tools like ChatGPT for vaccine development.
Discovered Materials is developing AI agents to identify new materials for the semiconductor industry, specifically addressing the challenge of increasing heat dissipation in high-power GPUs.

world.summary:
Commercial ships transiting the Panama Canal are facing significant cost increases due to the ongoing Iran war and reduced water levels caused by the El Ni



o weather phenomenon.
A top Iranian commander reportedly visited Iraq for meetings concerning the Iraqi government's strategy to disarm various armed groups and bring their weapons under state control.
Russian President Vladimir Putin issued a warning, stating that Moscow would respond with tit-for-tat seizures of European vessels if any European states seize ships carrying Russian cargo.
